dedupe_keys.name: comptages routiers sur la voirie departementale

description: Comptages routiers sur la voirie départementale is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Comptages routiers sur la voirie départementale Ce jeu de données présente les comptages routiers effectués sur la voirie départementale à partir de boucles électromagnétiques permanentes implantées dans la chaussée ou de compteurs routiers utilisant des tubes pneumatiques installés temporairement sur le réseau. Ces comptages ont une forte valeur ajoutée pour la compréhension des flux routiers. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are RD, Routes, Transport, Fréquentation, Voirie. The portal shows 368 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
